why: Method files — the capability layer of the Brain Library (owner item 15, 2026-11-05). Training modules (catalog/training/) teach Kingmaker how to reason; method files script what to do: each is an executable-structured markdown document whose fenced kingmaker-method block carries its inputs (the dials/thresholds) and its numbered, typed steps. lib/method-conductor.mjs discovers method files through THIS index, streams the chosen file down through the library read path, digests it (parses the steps) and conducts the actions. Future capability updates are just added or edited method files in this catalog; every install runs the exact same baseline system (the conductor), and conducted behavior changes when the file changes — proven by test/method-conductor.test.mjs (same code, two file versions, different conducted actions).
